# BTicino C300X Integration v2.1.1

## 2026-11-10

This patch release repairs the native display layer that 2.1.0 introduced. It
fixes the red `API error: 503` that could appear on the first page opened after
the display woke up, translates the alarm page's status error, and removes an
ambiguity in the home page button mode that could switch the device's home page
without anyone choosing it.

## Display

- The display's requests to Home Assistant are serialized. The agent forwards
  one request at a time and answers a second one with
  `display_command_pending`, so a page opened while the home page was still
  refreshing its buttons could fail once with a red `API error: 503`. Requests
  now queue; an overflowing queue reports the reason instead of dropping the
  request silently. The event long poll is unaffected.
- Pages asking for the same state share one round trip, so the home page
  buttons and a page's own status no longer cost two requests.
- A failed alarm status is reported in the configured language. It was the only
  status message that bypassed the display translations and printed the raw
  English transport string. The numeric code is kept in brackets.

## Home Page Buttons

- Changing the button mode re-applies the Display patch when the patch is
  active. Previously the new page reached the device only after turning the
  Display patch switch off and on again.
- A missing setting no longer means two different things. The dashboard form
  offered the dynamic buttons while applying the patch treated a missing
  setting as the fixed pair, so merely opening and saving the dashboard step
  could switch the home page. Existing entries keep the buttons they are
  running, recorded once on upgrade, and the form shows that state. New entries
  keep starting with the dynamic buttons.

## Upgrade

- The native agent stays at **2.1.0**. Only its bundle changes, because the
  display files ship with the agent, so the agent-update Repair offers the
  update and the integration re-applies an active Display patch itself. That
  restarts the device GUI once.
- Home Assistant 2026.7 remains the minimum. Existing integration entries and
  card configurations can be kept.

## Validation

- The release ran the full local and CI validation gates. The display layer is
  covered by source contract tests and a JavaScript harness only, because local
  tests do not execute the device's Qt runtime; the fixes in this release are
  not confirmed on hardware.
